page: Google Cloud Platform h4d-highmem-192-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance within the h4d family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. The system is equipped with 1488.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.75 GB per vCPU. It does not include any graphics processing units.

For local storage, this server configuration bundles 4027 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, distributed across 10 local SSDs. This high-capacity local storage provides direct, low-latency access to data. The instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high core count, substantial memory capacity, and integrated NVMe SSD storage, this instance offers a dense resource profile. It is designed for memory-intensive workloads that also require high-speed local storage, such as large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise applications, and data-intensive processing pipelines.
